t: Abu Jahl asking for the punishment by name
a: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ هَذَا هُوَ الْحَقَّ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ فَأَمْطِرْ عَلَيْنَا حِجَارَةً مِنَ السَّمَاءِ أَوِ ائْتِنَا بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
p: Allāhumma in kāna hādhā huwa-l-ḥaqqa min ʿindika fa-amṭir ʿalaynā ḥijāratan mina-s-samāʾi awi-ʾtinā bi-ʿadhābin alīm
m: O Allah, if this is the truth from You, then rain stones on us from the sky, or bring us a painful punishment.
